sanitized_error: [TOKEN ROTATION FAILURE: refresh token already consumed or OAuth session expired — re-authentication required]
impact: Terra and Luna Codex CLI threads cannot authenticate to execute fresh-context upgraded runs. Baseline runs queued before token expiry may have completed.

workaround.description: External Codex Desktop Terra/Luna threads may write raw output files directly to evals/w1/outputs/ following the filename convention and passing the attempt-output schema.
workaround.note: Each attempt from a distinct Codex thread must use a distinct attempt_index to avoid overwrite collisions. The run-w1-pilot.mjs runner discovers and registers these files.

resolution_path: Re-authenticate Codex CLI in Terra and Luna lanes, then re-run failed upgraded jobs.
